issues.where: the join at the top of the base, under the dark band
issues.what: a gap with bright specks showing through, so the glass is not seated and has no continuous shadow
issues.fix: close the gap, seat the sphere in the collar, and add the thin dark line under it

issues.where: the pond edge against the stones
issues.what: the water stops on a clean line against dry stones, with no wet darkening
issues.fix: darken and shine the stones at the waterline and add a thin meniscus

issues.where: the tree crown nearest the glass
issues.what: the leaves keep their width up to the glass, so the liquid does not enlarge them
issues.fix: enlarge and bend the interior through the curved liquid, strongest near the rim

issues.where: the loose grains where the sand thins into the dark
issues.what: the last grains are flat specks with no shadow under them
issues.fix: give those grains a little size and a contact shadow
